_comment: Recorded LLM transcript for the self-assembling-agent CI fixture.
Reference goal: 'fetch a URL, extract main text, and summarize it'.
Drives a deterministic 3-mutation lineage so the e2e fixture can assert
≥3 GRAPH_MUTATED events without paying for the real LLM call.
The reasoner reads responses[iteration-1] per iteration. Pair with
search-trace.json (next to this file) which provides matching candidates
per iteration so AddToFlow has something to splice in.
goal: fetch a URL, extract its main text, and summarize it

responses.need: fetch the raw contents of an HTTP(S) URL
responses.note: Need raw HTML before I can extract anything.

responses.need: extract the main article text out of HTML
responses.note: Need to strip navigation, ads, footers before summarizing.

responses.need: produce a short summary of long-form text
responses.note: Final step: summarize the cleaned article body.

responses.terminal_answer: Flow now does fetch → extract → summarize, which covers the goal end-to-end.
